retry_policy.evidence_quote: using compilation errors and numerical mismatches as structured feedback to drive targeted fixes until correctness is achieved

termination_condition.evidence_quote: After functional validation, the agent profiles the program with NVIDIA Nsight Sys-tems

cost_controls.note: Token usage is measured/analysed (pipeline/analyze_token_usage.py) but no budget cap or caching is described.
